tony_soprano.description: Lead. James Gandolfini. Italian-American man late 30s through late 40s. Heavy build, broad shoulders, dark hair receding to balding (mostly bald by S5-S6). Often in bowling shirts, polo shirts, or a bathrobe at home; suits when working. Acting/full boss of the DiMeo crime family.

carmela_soprano.description: Edie Falco. Tony's wife. Italian-American woman late 30s/40s. Blonde shoulder-length hair (often styled, sometimes longer with extensions), gold jewelry including a large crucifix necklace, French-manicured nails. Devout Catholic homemaker. Tall.

meadow_soprano.description: Jamie-Lynn Sigler. Tony and Carmela's daughter. Long dark hair, slim build, late-teens in S1 progressing through college and beyond by S6. Smart, opinionated.

aj_soprano.description: Robert Iler. Tony and Carmela's son. Round face, dark hair, chubby pre-teen in S1; grows into a depressed-looking teenager with longer dark hair by S5-S6.

livia_soprano.description: Nancy Marchand. Tony's elderly, embittered mother. Gray-white hair, large glasses, frail elderly Italian-American woman usually in a housecoat or in a nursing-home room.

junior_soprano.description: Dominic Chianese. Tony's elderly uncle. Wiry build, gray-white hair, large square aviator-style glasses, often in cardigans and sport coats. In S6 he's confused, in a hospital gown or halo brace.

christopher_moltisanti.description: Michael Imperioli. Tony's young protege and nephew-by-marriage. Italian-American man mid-20s in S1 aging through 30s. Slim, dark hair often slicked back, frequently in leather jackets and gold chains. Volatile, ambitious. Drug-using; appears gaunt at times.

paulie_walnuts.description: Tony Sirico. Tony's soldier and captain. Italian-American man 50s/60s. UNMISTAKABLE silver-and-black hair with distinct gray wings at the temples, slicked back. Dresses sharp in tracksuits or button-downs. Wiry, fastidious, superstitious.

silvio_dante.description: Steven Van Zandt. Tony's consigliere. Italian-American man 50s. UNMISTAKABLE helmet-like jet-black pompadour hair. Owns the Bada Bing strip club. Soft-spoken, usually in dark suits or leisure shirts.

big_pussy.description: Vincent Pastore. Tony's soldier and close friend. Heavy-set Italian-American man 40s/50s, large stomach, brown hair, usually in casual button-downs. Becomes an FBI informant in S1-S2.

hesh_rabkin.description: Jerry Adler. Older Jewish man, friend and financial advisor to Tony. Bearded, often in casual sweaters or button-downs. Lives on a horse farm.

artie_bucco.description: John Ventimiglia. Tony's lifelong friend, owner of Vesuvio (then Nuovo Vesuvio) restaurant. Italian-American man 40s, dark hair, often in chef's whites or casual shirts.

charmaine_bucco.description: Katherine Narducci. Artie's wife. Italian-American woman 40s, dark hair pulled back, often disapproving demeanor toward the mob life.

dr_melfi.description: Lorraine Bracco. Tony's psychiatrist. Italian-American woman 40s. Shoulder-length brown hair, professional skirt suits, usually in her therapy office in a leather chair.

father_phil.description: Paul Schulze. Catholic priest, close to Carmela. Young-ish dark-haired man in clerical collar and black shirt.

mikey_palmice.description: Al Sapienza. Junior Soprano's right-hand man and underboss in S1. Italian-American man 30s/40s, dark curly hair, hot-tempered.

jackie_aprile_sr.description: Michael Rispoli. Acting boss of the DiMeo family at start of S1, dying of cancer. Older Italian-American man, usually bedridden in hospital.

brendan_filone.description: Anthony DeSando. Young associate of Christopher's, drug user. Wiry build, long dark hair, often in leather jacket.

georgie.description: Bartender at the Bada Bing. Heavy-set bald man, often behind the bar.

irina_peltsin.description: Oksana Babiy. Tony's young Russian mistress in S1-S2. Long dark hair, Eastern European accent, often in lingerie or casual clothes.

richie_aprile.description: David Proval. Jackie Aprile Sr.'s older brother, fresh out of prison in S2. Wiry Italian-American man 50s, mustache, slicked-back graying hair, often in leather jacket. Tense, dangerous.

janice_soprano.description: Aida Turturro. Tony's older sister. Italian-American woman 40s/50s, long dark hair, sometimes with hippie/new-age styling ("Parvati"). Heavy build. Manipulative, sharp-tongued.

furio_giunta.description: Federico Castelluccio. Italian-born soldier who joins Tony's crew from Naples. UNMISTAKABLE long red-blond ponytail, beard, tall, broad. Italian accent. Wears flashy Italian suits.

adriana_la_cerva.description: Drea de Matteo. Christopher's girlfriend/fiancee. Italian-American woman 20s/30s with long curly auburn hair, heavy makeup, flashy revealing clothes. Becomes FBI informant.

jackie_aprile_jr.description: Jason Cerbone. Jackie Aprile Sr.'s son. Young dark-haired Italian-American man early 20s. Meadow's boyfriend for a stretch in S3.

ralph_cifaretto.description: Joe Pantoliano. Mob captain who arrives in S3. UNMISTAKABLE shaved head with prominent forehead, often sneering or with a mean smile, sharp suits or leather jackets. Volatile, sadistic.

gloria_trillo.description: Annabella Sciorra. Tony's S3 mistress, a Mercedes saleswoman. Italian-American woman 30s with short dark hair, professional attire, fiery temperament.

noah_tannenbaum.description: Patrick Tully. Meadow's first college boyfriend (S3). Young mixed-race man, slender, college-age.

bobby_baccalieri.description: Steven R. Schirripa. Junior's loyal underling, later a made man. UNMISTAKABLE very heavy-set Italian-American man, glasses, brown hair, usually in dark sport coats. Eventually marries Janice. Gentle demeanor.

valentina_la_paz.description: Leslie Bega. Ralph Cifaretto's mistress (S4) who later sleeps with Tony. Latina woman 30s with long dark hair.

joanne_moltisanti.description: Christopher's mother. Italian-American woman 50s/60s, mousy brown/gray hair, drab clothing. Bitter, complaining demeanor. Often shot in her cluttered home.

carmine_lupertazzi_sr.description: Tony Lip. NY Lupertazzi family boss. Heavy-set elderly Italian-American man, slicked-back gray hair, glasses, dark suits. Slow-spoken, imperious.

johnny_sack.description: Vincent Curatola. NY Lupertazzi underboss, eventually boss. Tall trim Italian-American man 50s, dark hair, often in dark double-breasted suits. Married to Ginny. Reserved, calculating.

ginny_sacrimoni.description: Denise Borino-Quinn. Johnny Sack's wife. VERY heavy-set Italian-American woman 40s/50s with dark hair, expensive clothing, soft-spoken.

agent_deborah_ciccerone.description: Lola Glaudini. FBI agent assigned to befriend Adriana under the cover name 'Danielle'. Italian-American woman 30s, dark hair, casual or fashionable clothing.

feech_la_manna.description: Robert Loggia. Old-school mobster fresh out of prison in S5. Older Italian-American man 70s, white hair, glasses, sport coats.

tony_blundetto.description: Steve Buscemi. Tony Soprano's cousin, released from prison in S5. UNMISTAKABLE thin gaunt face, bulging blue eyes, receding sandy-brown hair, often in plain blue-collar workwear or modest jackets. Skinny build (very different from Tony Soprano's heavy build). Same-name confusion is common — when both Tonys are onscreen, Tony Blundetto is the slim wiry one and Tony Soprano is the heavy bald one.

phil_leotardo.description: Frank Vincent. Lupertazzi capo, then boss. Elderly Italian-American man late 60s, gray slicked-back hair, prominent nose, expensive suits, deliberate manner. Cold, vengeful.

vito_spatafore.description: Joseph R. Gannascoli. Soprano family capo. Very heavy-set Italian-American man 40s, dark hair, jowly face, usually in dark suits or polo shirts. Secretly gay (revealed in S6). Loses significant weight in S6 in New Hampshire.

patsy_parisi.description: Dan Grimaldi. Soprano family soldier. Bald Italian-American man 50s, sad/serious face, dark casual clothes. Twin brother Philly is killed in S2.

eugene_pontecorvo.description: Robert Funaro. Soprano family soldier. Dark-haired Italian-American man 30s/40s, usually in casual button-downs.

benny_fazio.description: Max Casella. Younger Soprano family associate. Short Italian-American man 30s, dark hair, usually in tracksuits or casual clothing.

agent_harris.description: Matt Servitto. FBI agent assigned to organized crime. Middle-aged white man, short dark hair, professional but rumpled. Eventually becomes a complicit go-between.

rosalie_aprile.description: Sharon Angela. Jackie Aprile Sr.'s widow. Italian-American woman 40s/50s, long dark hair, heavy makeup, expensive casual clothing. Close friend of Carmela.

vito_jr.description: Brandon Hannan. Vito's troubled teenage son in S6. Overweight goth teenager with dyed black hair and Marilyn Manson aesthetic.
